name: Sandy Claws The Very First Christmas Bear
source:
Enjoy the magic of the season with the story of how a little brown bear becomes the very first Christmas bear.

Join Sandy, Princess Rayelle, and their forest friends as they traverse the Northern Woods in December to catch "the man in the red sleigh" as he and his reindeer leave the North Pole.

[From [url=https://williamclarke.itch.io/sandy-claws-the-very-first-christmas-bear]itch.io[/url]]
